sources.quote: $0.01 per 1 million tokens on cached prompts <128K
sources.supports: Google announced a $0.01 cached prompt price for Gemini 1.5 Flash-8B at stable release, before the June 2025 models.dev edit. The same announcement lists the $0.0375 input and $0.15 output prices.

sources.quote: Context caching price Free of charge, up to 1 million tokens of storage per hour $0.01, prompts <= 128k tokens $0.02, prompts > 128k tokens
sources.supports: Google's pricing page snapshot captured June 17, 2025 at 16:55:25 UTC lists the paid context caching rate as $0.01 per million cached tokens for prompts up to 128K, just before the models.dev commit.

sources.quote: Context caching price Free of charge, up to 1 million tokens of storage per hour $0.01, prompts <= 128k tokens $0.02, prompts > 128k tokens
sources.supports: A later Google pricing page snapshot on June 21, 2025 shows the same cached price; it was still listed after the models.dev field rename.

notes: Google had already announced and published the $0.01 cached input price by October 2024; its pricing page listed it both immediately before and after the June 2025 models.dev edit. The edit added an omitted provider price field, so there is no provider price-change effective date to report.
